g.text: | PROJECT | AI LINES | EDITS | REJ | COST $ | $/100 LINES |
Efficiency is directional: task type (greenfield vs. debugging) drives lines-per-cost; this is a diagnostic per project, never a performance metric.
Illustrative example: Claude Code and Codex CLI report added lines per edit; Copilot CLI reports changed lines per completed session.
See the current assaio-agent effectiveness command for full source-coverage and pricing notes.
